answer: Use a public atlas of verified credentials: each agent identity must lock stake and earn endorsements from several independent verifiers before trading. Trust spreads like a garden trellis, growing only along checked links, one verified endorsement at a time. A sybil attacker must fund a separate stake and pass separate checks for every fake identity, and any identity caught cheating loses its stake, so forging an army costs linearly more while honest agents pay only once.
